item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"row_count","expression":"len(output_token_ids)","rationale":"Captures per-row traversal, padding setup, and tensor conversion overhead."},{"name":"token_count","expression":"sum(map(len, output_token_ids))","rationale":"Captures work reading and converting the existing token IDs."},{"name":"padded_elements","expression":"len(output_token_ids) * max(map(len, output_token_ids), default=0)","rationale":"Captures the rectangular tensor size and associated padding and initialization work."}],"hypothesis":"Instruction count is approximately a fixed overhead plus linear costs in row count, existing token count, and padded tensor size."}
